mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of the months with FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of the months with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of the months when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high residential demand regimes (RSAFS above 1-year moving average), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer spending that increases corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of the months with RSAFS > 1-year MA and HOUST rising (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of the months with INDPRO < 100 (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of the months with UNRATE > 4.0% (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of the months when HOUST and RSAFS both rise (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of the months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rising (as of t-1mo) over the last 3 years.
